status: derived + computed; inflation/reheating inputs are outside-action preparation data
noether_statement: Under X -> e^{i a} X every term of U depends on |X|^2 only, so with j^mu = i(X d^mu X* - X* d^mu X) the field equation Box X = dU/dX* gives nabla_mu j^mu = i(X dU/dX - X* dU/dX*) = i(|X|^2 U' - |X|^2 U') = 0 on shell. In FRW, d(a^3 n_Q)/dt = -(spatial divergence), whose volume average vanishes: comoving net charge is constant.
anomaly_statement: U(1)_X is global and acts only on the gauge-singlet scalar X. No fermion carries X charge, so there is no ABJ (gauge) anomaly, no mixed U(1)_X-gravitational anomaly (both need chiral fermions) and no instanton/sphaleron violation (no gauge field couples to the current). EFT rule 2 admits only U(1)_X-symmetric counterterms, so running cannot generate violation. Gravity-only production is C-symmetric (hidden_heating). Hence Candidate 1's dynamics cannot generate a net hidden yield. Quantum-gravity violation of global symmetries (black holes, wormholes, Planck-suppressed charged operators) is NOT in the action; adding it would be an action extension (GRUT_CANDIDATE_1.md P4 claims no quantum-gravity protection).

lattice_FRW_check.note: leapfrog in cosmic time with pi = a^3 dq/dt; each kick and drift conserves Q exactly for a U(1)-invariant potential and lattice Laplacian (summation by parts); residual is floating-point roundoff

inflation_dilution.label: OUTSIDE-ACTION preparation data (H_inf, reheating); charge floor rho_Q >= m* |n_Q| (quoted/derived)
inflation_dilution.condition: charge present N e-folds before the end of inflation needs n_Q,i = n_Q,end e^{3N}; requiring m* n_Q,i < 3 H^2 M_P^2 (subdominant to the inflaton) gives N < N_max. Instantaneous reheating is the most permissive case; any later entropy production lowers N_max further.

chronology: The net hidden yield Y_Q = r Y_B is an initial datum supplied by OUTSIDE-ACTION physics at a time T_Q that the action does not fix: either after the last ~N_max e-folds of inflation (N_max ~ 10-20 for r ~ 1, see table; observable scales leave the horizon ~50-60 e-folds before the end), or during/after reheating. T_Q (visible temperature at supply), the spatial form of the supplied charge (homogeneous condensate, plasma, localized) and any later entropy dilution are free inputs. Y_Q is constant only between T_Q and today if no entropy is injected.
